examples.explanation: Each position is either abbreviated or kept, giving 2^4 = 16 variants; adjacent abbreviated runs merge into one number.
The single letter is either replaced by its count or kept.
Both letters abbreviated gives "2"; abbreviating one side gives "1b" and "a1"; keeping both gives "ab".

hints: Decide position by position: either extend the current abbreviated run or flush it and keep the letter.
Carry the pending abbreviation count through the recursion and append it whenever a letter is kept or the end is reached.
There are exactly 2^n results for a word of length n.
title: 409. Generalized Abbreviation
